Name: Shie's Portraits for SVE Content Patcher
Author: AlmostMidnight
AuthorLabel: Portraits by Shielia converted by AlmostMidnight
Description:
I love Shie's Portraits but unfortunately, Portraiture doesn't quite work for me most of the time and I prefer everyone to have the same portraits to avoid breaking immersion.

I made/edited some portraits to go with some of the newer NPCs in SVE, as well as changing the young wizard to go with SVE sprites made by Chaekal-Rizum, which you can find the SVE sprites [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9774]here[/url]. (I do have my own edited sprites for the young wizard that go more with the Cuter Sprites mod, if your interested let me know and I'll post it. :3)

Due to new config options, young wizard file is gone, and in optional files is a younger Claire. This mod requires Content Patcher and PyTK.
Hope you enjoy!

[b][u]UPDATE 2[/u]:[/b] As of version 1.2.0, my mod [u]does include the vanilla portraits[/u] and is compatible with SVE.[b] [u]DO NOT OVERWRITE THE OLD MOD[/u][/b], I had to change some file structure for the new config options. The wrinkles on some of the portraits make some characters look older, which isn't bad, but if you want a "younger" looking version then just change the config option to younger for that portrait. Beach portraits are separate so make sure you change them all!

[b]As of the last update, I added an article for manually editing your config. If you have GMCM, it is compatible with that as well so you can change the config in game.

[u]IMPORTANT[/u][/b]: My mod as of right now is NOT compatible with PYTK lite, honestly I'm unsure of how it works and differs from PYTK so for now please use the main version! The store portraits might be a little wonky or just straight-up not work but there is little I can do about it as it seems to be an issue across many other portrait mods. If I or someone else found a solution, I'll try my best to implement it.
